items.title: 68239_Ram Ramirez oral history interview
items.q: Mack Maddox had a place, another one of the early hours(?) bars...

ctx.x: And then the next week there Erroll had his own trio, and Charlie Parker was guest on his... That's the way the ball went, you know. Erroll just had too much talent. That was really not his bag of tricks. And he didn't conform to the basic pattern of Jazz and Bebop Jazz at that time.
Now, going back to Monk's time, I remember to the wee hours of the morning, a place called... Mack Maddox had a place, another one of the early hours(?) bars...
